text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! How do you do it, Jordan? Your
nails always
look so cute!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's such a stylish design! Even just
painting
them looks difficult. You're a
real pro, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you guys are into nail art? Hm... In
that
case, we can paint yours together if
you want.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If I have super striking stylish nails, I bet
people
will notice me! Can you make
that happen?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds easy enough. So, like, got any
specific
vibes or motifs in mind?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm... I can only think of boring stuff!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How about you base it on something
special to
you then?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If it was me, I'd get my mom's face on
one nail,
and Suzuka's face on another...
And everyone else
on my other nails!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Not gonna lie, that's a bit sus.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. Then I'd like my nails to be like,
pow in
the middle and glitzy around the
edges! Like
mu-mu-mun!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Um... Why don't we stick to just one
color for
now, 'kay?
